mods.abstract: Binocular microscope (serial number 266487) with heavy cast tilt base, bi-directional field frame for slides, macro and micro vernier focus, swivel optical head with removable pieces, interchangeable 5x and 10x eye pieces, lower field pieces, and adjustable flat and concave mirror for light source.
